title: The Farmer's Back Road
text: An old farmer waves you into his barn. He says he knows a sunken lane the Vossmark patrols never use.

success.say: The lane leads past an abandoned supply cart. +45 gold.

fail.say: A patrol was waiting at the end of the lane. Your army takes 12% damage getting out.

outcome.say: The map is good. +1 draft reroll.
You thank him and keep moving.

title: Downed Pilot
text: A fighter pilot is hanging from a tree by his parachute, one leg broken. Vossmark voices are getting closer.

outcome.say: It's a hard march. He gives you something from his flight bag.
You leave him water and take the flares. +1 Smoke Grenade.
Hearth logs the position for a rescue team. +2 meta-points.

title: Abandoned Field Hospital
text: A shelled aid station, tents half collapsed. Some of the supply crates are still sealed.

outcome.say: Your army patches up. Every squad heals 25%.

title: Strange Radio Signal
text: Your radio picks up chanting under the static. It's coming from a cellar a few hundred metres off the route.

outcome.say: Something in that cellar was guarding a relic.

title: The Glowing Crate
text: A Vossmark crate stamped with a lantern sigil. It is warm to the touch and faintly green at the seams.

outcome.say: It bites. But what's inside is powerful.

title: Supply Mix-up
text: A lost supply truck from another division offers to swap crates with you. Their manifest is smudged.

success.say: Their crate is full of trade goods. +60 gold.

fail.say: Spare boot laces. You're out 20 gold of rations.

title: Wounded Prisoner
text: A Vossmark private surrenders, bleeding. He keeps glancing at the tree line.

outcome.say: He gives up a supply cache and a patrol schedule. +25 gold, +2 meta-points.

choices.label: Patch him up and send him back

outcome.say: Your medic works fast. Your army is calmer for it. Every squad heals 15%.

title: Volunteers
text: A resistance cell has been holding this town on its own. Their leader asks to join you, or at least to share what they know.

outcome.say: A fresh Rifle Squad joins your army.
A day of drills with people who know the ground. Every squad gains 40 XP.

title: Abandoned Motor Pool
text: A Vossmark motor pool, abandoned in a hurry. Fuel drums, crates, and an armored car with a cracked engine block.

choices.label: Booby-trap the car and move on

outcome.say: Your sappers rig it. +1 Grenade Crate, +2 meta-points.
